277300796.description:
A lot of three cracked open geode pieces with sparkling druzy crystal interiors in shades of pink and deep purple. The color appears to be dyed rather than natural. Each piece has a rough tan and cream limestone exterior with a white banded rim around the crystal pocket. The largest is a triangular half, the second is a rounded oval half, and the third is a smaller piece with an open cavity and a few golden specks in the crystal lining. No maker marks or labels are present. Sold as a set of three loose specimens with no stands or box.

Condition: Natural rough surfaces with small chips and loose grit along the broken edges. Light soil on the outer rock. No cracks through the bodies.
